theme: NK cell receptor-mediated activation and inhibitory tolerance
core_role: The shared pathways frame NK cells, via KIR-type receptors, as balancing cytokine-producing activation against inhibitory restraint that enforces peripheral tolerance, the same inhibitory logic extended in the additional pathways to restraining T cell cytotoxicity.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing, polyadenylation and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are the nuclear birth of the mRNA 3' end (cleavage, polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing, Pol II termination), read here as the step that sets up the poly(A) tail and 3' end that the cytoplasmic deadenylation, decapping and decay machinery later acts on.

theme: Spliceosome assembly, pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear RNA surveillance
core_role: The shared pathways describe biogenesis of the splicing machinery itself (snRNA cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport, snRNP assembly), framed as supplying the spliceosome that carries out major/minor splicing alongside exosome-driven nuclear RNA surveillance and decay.

theme: B-vitamin, choline and carnitine micronutrient metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover uptake and metabolism of riboflavin, thiamine, choline and carnitine, framed as one-carbon/trimethylamine nutrient handling in which FMO-mediated oxidation (TMAU) and carnitine transport complete the picture.

theme: Endocrine control of growth and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the class I cytokine-receptor hormones (growth hormone, prolactin, leptin) signalling through JAK-STAT and IGF to regulate body growth, framed alongside thyroid hormone production and action as systemic endocrine regulators of growth and metabolism.

theme: Centrosome and centriole organisation for cilia and spindles
core_role: The shared pathways concern centriole duplication, basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly, framed as the centrosome's interphase ciliary role, the counterpart of its mitotic role as microtubule-organising centre for spindle assembly and orientation.

theme: Oncogenic FGFR signalling in cancer
core_role: The shared pathways are oncogenic FGFR1-3 fusion signalling, framed as one mode of aberrant FGFR activation in cancer alongside receptor amplification.

theme: Early neural plate and axial midline patterning
core_role: The shared pathways describe neural plate regionalisation and neuroepithelial differentiation, framed as neural tissue patterned by the notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm midline signals in the early embryo.

theme: Motile cilia and sperm flagellum function
core_role: The shared pathways are sperm-specific flagellar assembly and motility (mitochondrial sheath, motility regulation, Sertoli barrier), framed as the sperm instance of motile axoneme biology that also drives mucociliary clearance and CSF flow.

theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and catabolism of amino acids
core_role: The shared pathways center on lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, DLD) and the TCA cycle, framed as the entry hub through which pyruvate, lysine and branched-chain amino acid catabolism, with their inborn errors, feed acyl-CoAs into mitochondrial oxidation.

theme: B cell identity and B cell receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are generic lymphocyte and naive/memory B cell transcriptional signatures, framed as markers of mature B cell identity with BCR signalling and activation toward antibody production.

theme: T cell receptor signalling, costimulation and development
core_role: The shared pathways describe proximal TCR signalling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA coinhibition, framed as the signalling machinery governing T cell activation, thymic selection and differentiation.

theme: Replication stress response and DNA topology
core_role: The shared pathways describe changes in DNA topology and fork reversal during replication, framed as responses to replication stress (hydroxyurea, camptothecin, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks) that preserve genome stability.

theme: tRNA modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are anticodon modifications and cytosolic aminoacylation, framed as maintaining decoding accuracy, the same fidelity function served by mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble uridine thiolation.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar and dolichol supply for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways cover synthesis of dolichol-linked precursors and nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose) for N-glycosylation and GPI anchoring, with their congenital defects, framed as the sugar-donor supply that also includes sialic acid and CMP-sialic acid metabolism.

theme: Glucose, fructose and glycogen carbohydrate metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glycolysis and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation to lactate (with erythrocyte oxygen transport and hexokinase deficiency), framed as the central catabolic spine of a carbohydrate network that also includes gluconeogenesis, glycogen storage and fructose metabolism and their inherited disorders.

theme: Antimicrobial innate defence at mucosae
core_role: The shared pathways describe mucosal antibacterial effectors (agglutination, metal sequestration, bacterial cytolysis, limiting bacterial attachment and entry), framed as part of neutrophil- and humoral-mediated innate killing of bacteria and fungi.

theme: Cellular response to toxic heavy metals
core_role: The shared pathways cover cadmium and mercury detoxification and transport, framed as the core of a general cellular defence against toxic metal ions including cobalt, lead and selenium.

theme: Gonadal development, germ cells and reproductive endocrinology
core_role: The shared pathways describe germ cell specification, migration, proliferation and meiotic entry with activin/AMH signalling and Leydig differentiation, framed as gonadal germline and somatic development under the gonadotropin and steroid control of folliculogenesis and ovulation.

theme: Kidney development from intermediate mesoderm
core_role: The shared pathways concern controlling nephron progenitor survival, proliferation and maintenance to set kidney size, framed as the metanephric mesenchyme side of reciprocal induction with the ureteric bud during nephrogenesis.

theme: Post-translational hydroxylation and methylation of residues
core_role: The shared pathways are proline and lysine hydroxylation, framed as a class of amino-acid side-chain modifications alongside lysine methylation.

theme: Oxidative stress, ischaemia and ferroptotic cell death
core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular responses to peroxides, hydrogen sulfide and ischaemia, framed as oxidative stress whose iron-dependent lipid peroxidation can culminate in ferroptosis.

theme: Amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism, framed as the nitrogen-handling transamination hub linking the broader catabolism of amino acids (tyrosine, phenylalanine, proline) to the TCA cycle and gluconeogenesis.

theme: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe copper and manganese import, transport and detoxification (including aceruloplasminemia), framed as one arm of transition-metal homeostasis alongside SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport.

theme: Golgi–endosome–lysosome membrane trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are retrograde and anterograde transport between endosomes and the Golgi with Golgi retention, framed as trafficking routes that deliver cargo for lysosome biogenesis.

theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase signalling in haematopoiesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe FLT3 signalling including ITD and fusion mutants, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation, framed as aberrant haematopoietic cytokine-receptor kinase signalling alongside PDGFR mutants and G-CSF/TPO signalling.

theme: Replication stress response and genome stability
core_role: The shared pathways cover resolving replication obstacles (DNA-protein crosslinks, R-loops, hydroxyurea and camptothecin responses) and origin firing, framed as protecting replication forks with fork reversal, topological changes and end-joining repair.

theme: Sister chromatid cohesion establishment and resolution
core_role: The shared pathways describe cohesin loading and cohesion establishment (with chromatin looping), framed as the first stage of a cohesion cycle that is maintained at centromeres and then resolved at chromatid separation.

theme: Arachidonic acid–derived eicosanoid synthesis and signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are the COX and P450 epoxygenase/omega-oxidation branches producing prostaglandins, thromboxanes and hepoxilins and their regulation (fever, PGE response), framed within the broader eicosanoid and fatty-acid oxygenation network including lipoxygenase and HETE pathways.

theme: Mitochondrial gene expression
core_role: The shared pathways concern mitochondrial RNA processing, stability, modification and mitoribosome assembly, framed as the post-transcriptional and translational stages of mitochondrial gene expression downstream of mtDNA replication and transcription.

theme: Erythrocyte membrane and gas transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe Rh-associated membrane transport proteins (RHAG, Rh-null anaemia), framed as erythrocyte membrane components serving red cell exchange of oxygen, carbon dioxide and nitric oxide.

theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are recruitment of proteins to mitotic centrosomes and AURKA activation, framed as centrosome maturation driving spindle formation and regulated by PLK1/AURKA and the spindle checkpoint.

theme: Host–pathogen interaction in myeloid cells
core_role: The shared pathways cover pathogen and toxin uptake, NADPH oxidase activation and anti-inflammatory macrophage responses, framed as myeloid and dendritic-cell host defence against microbes and protozoa with cytokine-tuned antigen presentation.

theme: Cellular senescence and proliferative arrest
core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of senescence (oncogene-induced) and blocking cell-cycle re-entry, framed as the arrest arm of senescence that is accompanied by SASP secretion and Polycomb-controlled CDKN2A silencing.

theme: Telomere protection and maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways describe telomere capping and protection from end-joining and t-circle formation, framed as preserving telomere ends while recombination and replication-based maintenance mechanisms act on them.

theme: B cell activation and germinal centre responses
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell/lymphocyte signatures and BCR signalling, framed as the starting B cell state that is driven, with T follicular help and costimulation, into proliferation, germinal centre differentiation and humoral memory.

theme: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose uptake
core_role: The shared pathways describe adiponectin signalling and regulation of glucose import and insulin sensitivity, framed as control of insulin-stimulated GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake.

theme: Neurotransmitter synthesis, release and reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways cover cholinergic transmission (choline transport, acetylcholine synthesis and release, neuromuscular synapse, SLC5A7 disease), framed as one neurotransmitter system among GABA, glycine and glutamate handling at synapses.

theme: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose absorption
core_role: The shared pathways describe carbohydrate digestion and intestinal/renal hexose transport with their transporter deficiencies, framed as uptake of dietary sugars alongside related glycoside transport.

theme: NAD metabolism and mitochondrial energy carrier transport
core_role: The shared pathways are nicotinate/NAD+ salvage and turnover, framed as NAD cofactor supply linked to mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and creatine phosphate energy buffering.

theme: Cellular energy buffering and nucleotide cofactor interconversion
core_role: The shared pathways describe the phosphocreatine shuttle and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, framed as energy transfer linked to interconversion of nucleotide and NAD cofactor pools.

theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response
core_role: The shared pathways describe p53 activation by phosphorylation and its loss in cancer, promoting intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage, framed as the pro-apoptotic arm of a p53 program that also enforces cell-cycle arrest and senescence.

theme: Endoderm and pancreatic lineage specification
core_role: The shared pathways describe pancreatic progenitor and endocrine lineage programs, framed as the pancreatic branch of endoderm development from definitive endoderm and foregut.

theme: Amino acid catabolism and organic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover threonine, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism among general amino/organic acid pathways, framed as part of broad amino acid catabolism including aromatic, proline and histidine breakdown and glycine conjugation.

theme: Cardiac electrophysiology and conduction
core_role: The shared pathways describe cardiac action potential phases, pacemaker and conduction-system signalling, framed as the electrical basis of heart rhythm along with His-Purkinje development and gap-junction coupling.

theme: Cellular senescence under oxidative and p53 stress
core_role: The shared pathways describe stress-induced senescence with dampening of p53-dependent apoptosis and stress kinase signalling, framed as a choice of senescent arrest rather than death, with SASP and Polycomb-controlled entry.

theme: Amyloid-beta handling and microglial neuroinflammation
core_role: The shared pathways describe amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance, framed as the substrate of Alzheimer-type pathology handled by microglial activation, lysosomal clearance and glial responses.

theme: Mitochondrial gene expression
core_role: The shared pathways concern mitochondrial RNA stability, modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, framed as the post-transcriptional stages following mitochondrial transcription with ribosome quality control.
